up: List all compounds reported in document CHEMBL5113380. For each compound, return its ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Sort the results by the ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5113380' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
